shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile in low relief
animals carved on a tall upright slab/pillar face
superimposed/stacked animal figures in vertical sequence
reptile or serpentine creature below the quadruped
justification: Both show low-relief animals in strict profile stacked vertically on the broad face of a tall upright slab, with a quadruped above and a lower elongated/reptilian creature beneath, rendered in the same flat, outlined, schematic relief convention with no infill detail. B is far richer, with a horizontal register of repeated arched-animal motifs and a zigzag band across the top plus birds and a snake-like descending form, whereas A shows only one or two isolated figures on an otherwise blank surface.
